verdict.rationale: Persistent network storage is a fair question for a serverless GPU platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents volumes, network file systems, or any storage that persists across container teardown. The material covers GPU selection, pricing, environments, SDKs and sandboxes, none of which addresses persistent datasets or checkpoints.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach persistent network storage that survives instance teardown, so datasets and checkpoints outlive any single GPU rental
